metadata.time_basis: AESO published Alberta hour-ending labels (1-24), not UTC or Ontario EST. Spring omits HE02; autumn repeats HE02 as HE02*. Both autumn observations enter the HE02 bin. Bins store hour=HE-1 only as an index, not an hour-beginning timestamp.
metadata.method: Arithmetic mean of every observed pool-price hour within each month; every month counts equally in the headline and model benchmark. Pool energy only: no retail fees, losses, delivery, taxes or Ontario Global Adjustment. Not a customer-weighted price, bill or forecast.
metadata.day_type_rule: Saturday/Sunday are weekends; statutory holidays retain their calendar weekday.
metadata.revisions: All archived months are re-downloaded and cross-checked on each run. An already archived hourly price or monthly value that changes stops publication for review; no AESO correction deadline is assumed. History is never shortened.
metadata.permission: Owner-confirmed AESO permission covers public raw hourly archives and derived charts/benchmarks; the project has not independently inspected the grant.

source_codes.aeso_hourly: AESO ETS Historical Pool Price CSV ($/MWh), exact requested dates.
source_codes.aeso_monthly: AESO Pool Monthly Summary arithmetic average ($/MWh).
